name: webpack-externals-needed-for-undici-in-non-client-builds
hook: webpack externals for undici/@napi-rs/canvas are required in non-client builds to prevent UnhandledSchemeError
body: webpackConfig.externals for undici and @napi-rs/canvas in non-client builds (guarded with !isClient) are REQUIRED to prevent webpack from analyzing these packages' internal code. Without externals, webpack analyzes undici's source and encounters node: protocol imports (node:dns, node:console, etc.) which cause UnhandledSchemeError in non-client builds because there is no plugin to handle node: URL schemes. serverExternalPackages only prevents Next.js from bundling into the serverless function — webpack still analyzes the code for the client build when it's imported via shared config files like payload.config.ts.
why: payload.config.ts imports payload which imports undici. When webpack analyzes payload.config.ts for the client build, it traces into undici and encounters node: imports that it cannot handle. Only externals prevent this analysis.

name: node-native-binary-alias-needed-with-false-fallback
hook: .node$ alias to empty-stub.js plus resolve.fallback.node=false is required to prevent browser binary errors
body: The .node$ alias to empty-stub.js combined with resolve.fallback.node=false is REQUIRED. Without it, webpack encounters @napi-rs/canvas's .node binary files and throws 'Node.js binary module is not supported in the browser'. The alias redirects .node files to an empty stub so webpack can proceed. resolve.fallback.node=false prevents webpack from providing Node.js polyfills. Both settings are needed together and must NOT be removed independently.
why: @napi-rs/canvas is a native Node.js addon with .node binary files that cannot execute in the browser. The .node$ alias is the only way to prevent webpack from failing when it encounters these files during analysis.
